test_vectors.coverage: Empty V1 and V2 models, default version, independent model versions, and u32::MAX in every version component.
V1 role strings gain empty includes and descriptions; errors and headers are empty; declaration order and original document are preserved.

Unsorted service, endpoint, field, definition, role, and enum order; u16 and u32 identity boundaries; i32 enum extrema; UTF-8, NUL, CR, LF, and TAB metadata; forward aliases and recursive nominal structs.
Exact V2 import and export including role inheritance, descriptions, error codes and messages, and original header casing and required flags.
V1 and V2 exported data remain unchanged after source mutation, including nested fields and V2-only metadata.
All 23 EndpointType variants across three endpoint positions, with additional NanoId length, empty nominal, EnumRef flag, and nested Optional vectors; both legacy formats round-trip exactly.
Eight loss-prevention vectors covering errors, optional headers, unused role includes, descriptions including whitespace and NUL, combined metadata, and successful exact V2 preservation.

Nineteen invalid service, endpoint, role, field, nominal declaration, reference, enum discriminant, NanoId, and alias-cycle vectors; exact registry errors and unchanged source models on both import and export paths.
Unknown included roles, role cycles, duplicate error codes and names, case-insensitive header collisions, and unknown header types; registry validation precedes V1 compatibility errors.
MAX_REFERENCE_DEPTH nested ownership edges are accepted; one additional edge returns the original DepthLimitExceeded error on every conversion path.
Case-distinct role identifiers and unused role declarations survive in original order.
